check_constraints.name: address_operational_profiles_check
check_constraints.definition: CHECK (((temperature_min IS NULL) OR (temperature_max IS NULL) OR (temperature_min <= temperature_max)))

check_constraints.name: cmr_documents_regulatory_kind_scope_check
check_constraints.definition: CHECK (((document_kind <> ALL (ARRAY['deca'::text, 'ecmr'::text])) OR (regulatory_scope IS NOT NULL)))

check_constraints.name: external_service_mappings_dates_ck
check_constraints.definition: CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_from IS NULL) OR (valid_to >= valid_from)))

check_constraints.name: fuel_index_bands_surcharge_ck
check_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((surcharge_percent IS NOT NULL) AND (surcharge_amount IS NULL) AND (surcharge_percent >= (0)::numeric)) OR ((surcharge_percent IS NULL) AND (surcharge_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (surcharge_amount >= (0)::numeric))))

check_constraints.name: regulatory_document_access_tokens_public_until_minimum_check
check_constraints.definition: CHECK (((service_completed_at IS NULL) OR (public_until IS NULL) OR (public_until >= (service_completed_at + '7 days'::interval))))

check_constraints.name: tariff_zone_members_shape_ck
check_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((member_type = 'COUNTRY'::text) AND (admin_division_code IS NULL) AND (postal_code IS NULL) AND (postal_range_from IS NULL) AND (postal_range_to IS NULL) AND (postal_prefix IS NULL)) OR ((member_type = 'ADMIN_DIVISION'::text) AND (admin_division_code IS NOT NULL) AND (postal_code IS NULL) AND (postal_range_from IS NULL) AND (postal_range_to IS NULL) AND (postal_prefix IS NULL)) OR ((member_type = 'POSTAL_CODE'::text) AND (postal_code IS NOT NULL) AND (admin_division_code IS NULL) AND (postal_range_from IS NULL) AND (postal_range_to IS NULL) AND (postal_prefix IS NULL)) OR ((member_type = 'POSTAL_RANGE'::text) AND (postal_range_from IS NOT NULL) AND (postal_range_to IS NOT NULL) AND (admin_division_code IS NULL) AND (postal_code IS NULL) AND (postal_prefix IS NULL)) OR ((member_type = 'POSTAL_PREFIX'::text) AND (postal_prefix IS NOT NULL) AND (admin_division_code IS NULL) AND (postal_code IS NULL) AND (postal_range_from IS NULL) AND (postal_range_to IS NULL))))

check_constraints.name: transit_times_value_ck
check_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((transit_mode = 'MINUTES'::text) AND (planned_duration_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (planned_duration_minutes >= 0) AND (business_days IS NULL)) OR ((transit_mode = 'BUSINESS_DAYS'::text) AND (business_days IS NOT NULL) AND (business_days >= 0) AND (planned_duration_minutes IS NULL))))

unique_constraints.name: hazmat_entry_synonyms_hazmat_entry_id_tenant_id_locale_syno_key
unique_constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (hazmat_entry_id, tenant_id, locale, synonym)

unique_constraints.name: inventory_quants_bin_id_product_id_owner_party_id_batch_num_key
unique_constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (bin_id, product_id, owner_party_id, batch_number, serial_number, stock_status)

unique_constraints.name: party_addresses_tenant_id_party_id_code_key
unique_constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (tenant_id, party_id, code)

unique_constraints.name: party_roles_tenant_id_party_id_company_id_role_code_key
unique_constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (tenant_id, party_id, company_id, role_code)

unique_constraints.name: products_tenant_id_customer_id_sku_key
unique_constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (tenant_id, customer_id, sku)
